rows.en: It suddenly went berserk!? Is it because that thing from before possessed it!?
It suddenly went berserk!? Is it because that thing from before possessed it!?
It suddenly went berserk!? Is it because that thing from before possessed it!?
Grrruuu...
What was that just now? I've got a bad feeling about this...
What was that just now...? I've got a bad feeling about this.
What was that just now...? I've got a bad feeling about this...
What was that just now? I've got a bad feeling about this...
What was that just now? I've got a bad feeling about this...
What was that just now? I've got a bad feeling about this...
What the hell was that just now...? I've got a damn bad feeling about this.
What was that just now? I've got a bad feeling about this...
What was that just now? I've got a bad feeling about this...
...Hey. We've wound up in another lab-looking place.
This had better not be another trap.
On top of that, there's no sign of any Yummy, and I can't collect any Medals. Damn it!
Come on, don't be like that, Ankh. With more allies, we'll be able to collect more Medals too.
Tch. Fine, but in exchange, I want a year's supply of ice pops.
...Okay, okay. I'll figure something out.
...Speaking of Medals, I once overheard the enemy talking about them.
Really? What did they say?
Well, I didn't catch the details...
Tch...! Still, it looks like the enemy's started paying attention to the Medals' power.
A kaijin lies collapsed on the floor.
This again...? I'm sick of it!
...Something's off about this kaijin. Its surface has changed into something like metal scales...
...Something's off about this kaijin. Its surface has changed into something like metal scales...
This kaijin is strange. Its surface is changing... It looks like iron scales...
This kaijin is strange. Its surface is changing... It looks like iron scales...
...This kaijin's weird. Its skin's turned into something like iron scales.
...Don't you think this kaijin is strange? Its surface has changed into something like metal scales...
...Ain't there somethin' off about this kaijin? Its hide's gone all iron scales, dammit.
...Something's wrong! This kaijin's surface looks like metal scales...
...This kaijin's weird. Its surface has changed into something like metal scales...
...This kaijin is strange. Its surface has changed into something like metal scales...
Hmph. Is this some kind of experiment too?
Those are DG Cells...
Who's there...!?
It's me...
You again...
This kaijin is infected with DG Cells. There's no doubt about it.
DG... Cells...? What are those?
With its three great theories, "Self-Regeneration," "Self-Multiplication" and "Self-Evolution,"
they're the metal cells that make up Devil Gundam's body.
With DG Cells, a body is made stronger, and can even come back to life again and again...
...Sounds like something dangerous.
...Sounds like something dangerous.
...Sounds like something dangerous.
...Sounds like something dangerous.
...It seems to be something dangerous.
...Sounds like something dangerous.
...Sounds like something dangerous.
...Sounds like something dangerous.
...It seems to be something dangerous.
...Sounds like something dangerous.
Yeah... It depends on how far along the enemy's research is, but...
the only way to stop it is to take down Devil Gundam.
You won't be getting past here, you know?
Bee Woman!! I thought we'd already defeated you!!
That was just a warm-up. The real show starts now!!
Igiiiiiiiih!! Don't you dare underestimate our science.
You... Zanjioh!!
Now, come forth! Revived Kaijin Army!!
Brrrrrrr!
Hahahahaha!!
Kikikikiki!!
Revived kaijin? No matter what comes, I'll defeat it!
Revived kaijin! I'll take you all down at once!!
Revived kaijin? Then it's a climax for every last one of ya!!
Revived kaijin? No matter what comes, I'll defeat it!
Revived kaijin? No matter what comes, I'll defeat it!
Revived kaijin? Whatever comes, I'll take it down!!
Revived kaijin? More new enemies!!
Revived kaijin? Now they've brought out something strange again!!
Revived kaijin? Whatever comes... I'll eliminate the target!
Revived kaijin? Whatever comes... I'll complete the mission.
These guys have been powered up by Shocker's proud regeneration technology!!
Now, you lot! Dispose of those Lost Heroes!!

notes.note: Gomora growl has no earlier English in the corpus (048/049 untranslated); rendered 'Grrruuu...'.
Silent '???' (the stranger from 0320/0321, presumably Domon / God Gundam) and Gomora: ellipsis only.
Party variants #0.59-#0.67; #0.60 and #0.65 rougher (#0.65 Momotaros-style). Phrasing matches the existing W line 'a bad feeling about this'.
Ankh demands a year's supply of ice pops from Eiji as the price for accepting more allies; 'Fine, but' carries the concession implied by the exchange.
Narration; kaijin singular per context (following rows say 'this kaijin').
Party variants #0.3-#0.12; tone per wording (#0.8 suave question, #0.9 Momotaros-style, #0.12 polite).
No speaker recovered; sits after the 10 party variants. Contemptuous 'Hmph' fits Ankh, but kept speaker-neutral.
'???' is the stranger hunting Devil Gundam (likely Domon/God Gundam; not revealed yet, so no name used). 'DG Cells' per G Gundam English usage; not in glossary.

Sentence split across #0.21/#0.22, cut at the same point. 'Self-Regeneration, Self-Multiplication, Self-Evolution' follow the standard G Gundam English for the Devil Gundam's three theories. Opening tightened to "With its three great theories," to fit the box ("its" points ahead to the cells in #0.22).
Impersonal 'a body' kept: the source states a general property, no specific subject.
Variants #0.24-#0.33; polite forms (#0.28, #0.32 labelled Mebius) use 'It seems to be'. #0.33 also labelled Mebius but plain form; translated as written.
#0.35 trails into #0.36 ('...but / the only way...'), so #0.36 starts lowercase to match the cut.
Subject 'we' restored (the heroes beat Bee Woman in 0312; she fled).
Zanjioh's cry rendered 'Igiiiiiiiih!!' (new; no earlier English).
Todogiller 'Brrrrrrr!' and Bat Man 'Kikikikiki!!' match earlier slices; Spider Man laugh plain 'Hahahahaha!!'.
Party variants #0.10-#0.19: #0.12 Momotaros (climax), #0.18 00/Setsuna ('eliminate the target'), #0.19 Wing Zero/Heero ('complete the mission'). 'it' used for 'whatever comes'.
No speaker recovered; sits between Zanjioh lines and boasts of Shocker tech, so read as Zanjioh (or Bee Woman).

report: 80/80 rows. Unrecovered speakers: 0323#0.13 (likely Ankh) and 0325#0.20 (likely Zanjioh). New sounds: Gomora growl 'Grrruuu...', Zanjioh 'Igiiiiiiiih!!'. Not in glossary: DG Cells; Self-Regeneration/Self-Multiplication/Self-Evolution; Revived Kaijin Army. '???' kept unnamed (likely Domon/God Gundam).
